tasks.label: Smoke test account and habits API
args: const email = `smoke-${Date.now()}@daymark.local`; const password = 'DaymarkSmoke123!'; const call = async (path, token, method = 'GET', body) => { const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:8080${path}`, { method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) }, ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`${method} ${path}: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`); return response.status === 204 ? null : response.json(); }; const auth = await call('/api/auth/register', null, 'POST', { name: 'Smoke Test', email, password, timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }); const token = auth.accessToken; const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('sv-SE', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }).format(new Date()); const habit = await call('/api/habits', token, 'POST', { name: 'Morning reading', category: 'Mind', icon: 'book', color: 'green', goal: '20 min', weeklyTarget: 3, scheduledDays: ['MONDAY', 'WEDNESDAY', 'FRIDAY'] }); await call(`/api/habits/${habit.id}/check-ins`, token, 'POST', { date: today, completed: true }); const habits = await call('/api/habits', token); console.log(JSON.stringify({ registered: auth.user.email === email, habitCreated: habits.length === 1, checkInSaved: habits[0]?.completed === true, streak: habits[0]?.streak, scheduleDays: habits[0]?.scheduledDays.length }));
